scope:
Prepare inactive source-connected recovery components, never runtime authority.

The trusted local solve-context pickle and every research input are supplied
explicitly and pinned by SHA256. This producer does not run a fit, promote an
owner, change a source point, or apply any generated height domain.

method.blockingFootprint: Exact nonzero support of every retained direct conflicting row; alternatives are recorded, not all mathematically required controls.
method.recoveryClosure: Source-distance-bounded least all-arm closure under the stated modeled-datum grade/curvature budget. A source-connected complete physical-node branch may enter; an independent projected overlap may not.
method.nullElevation: Unknown/null source height is not surveyed zero. New negative-to-current-ground parameter domains are modeled component proposals tied to the retained actual underpass proof.
method.frontierNormalization: Budget observations are deduplicated and removed after complete merged-group closure when selected by any seed in that group; remaining observations are provisional and impose no fixed height.
method.contiguousRuns: Every finiteRecoveryWindow is an exact contiguous run of selected controls; no unselected gap is included.
